messages.subject: Scheduled maintenance: document management system Sat 19 Oct
messages.plaintextBody:
The firm's DMS will be unavailable from 22:00 on Saturday 19 October until 02:00 Sunday for scheduled maintenance and indexing upgrades. Please save and close all open documents beforehand. Email will be unaffected.

IT Helpdesk
